name: prism-control-plane
description: Metering and policy plane for commercial Prism: client keys, entitlements, usage ledger, and a metered proxy to Cloudflare AI Gateway / Workers AI (AGPL-3.0).
author: Conrad Rockenhaus

scripts.bootstrap: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('wrangler.toml')){console.error('wrangler.toml already exists; not overwriting.');process.exit(1)}fs.copyFileSync('wrangler.example.toml','wrangler.toml');console.log('Created wrangler.toml from wrangler.example.toml. Fill in database_id and AI_GATEWAY_ID before deploying.')"
